## Checklist

- [ ] CI is expected to pass (`npm run build`, Python compile/tests, Windows `cargo check` when Rust changed).
- [ ] [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) and `docs/logs/` are updated when the change is user-visible or touches process/docs.
- [ ] [README.md](../README.md) and [README.es.md](../README.es.md) stay in sync if one of them changed.
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, voice profiles, or model weights are included.
